title: Surreal Cosmic Bell Tower
description: A massive bronze bell with mechanical attachments hangs from above, emitting particles and light. Below it, a winding wooden staircase ascends from turbulent blue waves toward a dark stone tower wrapped in flowing brown fabric, while a giant green robotic hand reaches from the right and a floating eye appears in a red rectangle.
